We need to return all possible precursors of applying the template (1914391) to the molecule from make_5_lvl1-template_search-5? Actually that task gave mapped_rxn and template_id. The molecule to apply is likely the product from previous step? The earlier input from make_5_lvl1-apply_template-4 gave precursors list: ["CCOC(C[C@@H]1O[C@H](/C=C(/C)C(OC)=O)[C@H](C)[C@@H](O)CH2)=O", "O=S(=O)(O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C(F)(F)F"] That's unrelated.

Now we need to apply template 1914391 to the molecule "below". The question: "Can you return all possible precursors of applying the template as the result of the task make_5_lvl1-template_search-5 to the molecule below?" The molecule below likely is the product from previous step? Not given explicitly. But we have mapped_rxn showing product side: product SMILES is after >>. The product SMILES: "[CH3:1][CH2:2][O:3][C:4](=[O:5])[CH2:6][C@H:7]1[CH2:8][C@H:9]([OH:10])[C@@H:11]([CH3:12])[C@@H:13](/[CH:14]=[C:15](/[CH3:16])[C:17](=[O:18])[O:19][CH3:20])[O:21]1". That's the target molecule for retrosynthesis. So we need to apply template 1914391 in reverse (i.e., retrosynthetic) to get precursors. The apply_template tool expects forward reaction? It applies template to molecule to get precursors (retro). Should work. But we got errors due to SMILES formatting maybe need to use isomeric SMILES exactly as product. Let's use the product SMILES from mapped_rxn.
